comment: Lines still to be recorded for the coming 48 kHz voice re-render (openspec/changes/comms-middle-ground). Not referenced at runtime: until they exist, these moments reuse recorded clips (lib/comms/comms_moments.dart) or stay quiet. Fields follow art/comms/lines.json: trigger is a GameEvent name, speaker a cast id, emotion the delivery. Demon lines are grunts (kind) with a SIGINT gloss. When rendered, append them to lines.json under their trigger (never reorder existing clips).

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: The hatch is open! Hit the core, now!
lines.why: Only bossPhase.h2 (field down) and bossPhase.h0 fit today.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Core's exposed. Put everything into that hatch!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: It opened its mouth! Feed it!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Sentinel's cornered. It's going all in, watch it!
lines.why: No bank line describes a sentinel's last stand; lastStandTell stays silent.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Last one standing is charging up. Get ready to move.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: It's alone and it's angry. Dodge, then finish it!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Next wave on the horizon. Finish these stragglers.
lines.why: incoming reuses waveStart.h0/h2/h4 today; a horizon call would fit better.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: More of them coming out of the haze. Clean up fast.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Fresh wing in the fog, closing. Mop up and reset.

lines.speaker: gorrak
lines.gloss: The next wing is already here!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Escort wing forming around the sentinel. Thin them first.
lines.why: The model's escort event reuses the generic sentinelIncoming lines.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Bodyguards inbound. The big one won't come down until they're placed.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: They're feeding this wave! More dropping in behind!
lines.why: Mid-wave flocks reuse the reinforcements lines; a wave-specific call adds variety.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Wait, the wave isn't over? They brought backup!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion sees you overhead. Keep that cover on us!
lines.why: Air-cover lines exist only inside groundForceInRange; a dedicated call when the ship flies over the fight (groundPicture over) would be clearer.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Flyer's right above us! Push forward, push!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Air cover's drifted off. Pilot, swing back over the convoy!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Regroup on the carrier lane. Briefing in a moment.
lines.why: Transition interludes reuse levelClear and transmissionMission.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Shopping break! Grab the shiny stuff before the next wave.
